Threat_Event: Unauthorised user or attacker reaches protected services
Vulnerability_or_Control_Gap: Broad firewall permit; broad SSH scope; incomplete segmentation
Recommended_Actions: Remove broad permit; limit SSH by source and admin role; enforce segmentation; review rules quarterly
Assumptions_and_Limitations: Rule order; active use; and compensating controls need validation
Acceptance_Evidence: Approved rule review; exported active configuration; segmentation test; SSH allow-list evidence
Review_Cadence: Quarterly and after material network change

Asset_or_Process: Research VLAN and legacy lab equipment
Threat_Event: Approved exception is used outside its documented purpose
Vulnerability_or_Control_Gap: Incomplete approval; legacy equipment; and uncertain source enforcement
Recommended_Actions: Reapprove with expiry; restrict to verified source and ports; monitor; isolate equipment; set replacement plan
Assumptions_and_Limitations: Log traffic may be approved NAT or vendor activity
Acceptance_Evidence: Signed approval with expiry; verified source and port test; monitoring report; isolation evidence

Threat_Event: Remote attacker exploits web weakness or input flaw
Vulnerability_or_Control_Gap: Apache weakness; missing headers; suspicious requests
Recommended_Actions: Patch platform; remediate application issue; add headers; review WAF; test after fix; triage alerts
Assumptions_and_Limitations: Evidence indicates probing and weakness; not a confirmed breach
Acceptance_Evidence: Patch and version evidence; security header scan; post-fix test; alert triage record

Threat_Event: Attacker obtains device information or changes configuration
Vulnerability_or_Control_Gap: Default SNMP strings or credentials and reachable management services
Recommended_Actions: Change all default credentials; use SNMPv3; restrict management network; rotate secrets; review device logs
Assumptions_and_Limitations: Successful SNMP authentication is not confirmed
Acceptance_Evidence: Credential rotation evidence; SNMPv3 configuration; management ACL test; device-log review

Risk_Title: MFA service outage and unsafe fallback
Threat_Event: MFA provider degradation prevents secure access or drives unsafe workarounds
Vulnerability_or_Control_Gap: Failover and continuity design need verification; user friction
Recommended_Actions: Test failover; define time-bound fallback; monitor anomalies; improve user communication and support
Assumptions_and_Limitations: Authentication failures may be outage-related rather than hostile
Acceptance_Evidence: Documented fallback procedure; failover test results; outage log review; user communication artefact
Review_Cadence: Quarterly and after provider change or incident

Asset_or_Process: SIS database; backups; and change process
Threat_Event: Data is exposed; intercepted; altered; or service change cannot recover
Vulnerability_or_Control_Gap: Plaintext backups; TLS 1.0; local keys; no rotation; missing rollback and approvals
Existing_Controls: AES-256 database encryption and change record
Recommended_Actions: Encrypt backups; retire TLS 1.0; use managed keys and rotation; require CAB approval; document and test rollback
Assumptions_and_Limitations: Assessment date and remediation status require confirmation
Acceptance_Evidence: Encrypted backup proof; TLS scan; key rotation record; CAB approval; successful restore and rollback test

Threat_Event: Plugin or vendor accesses more data than necessary
Vulnerability_or_Control_Gap: OAuth deployment preceded central security review
Recommended_Actions: Review OAuth scopes; perform vendor assessment; apply least privilege; approve before continued use
Assumptions_and_Limitations: No evidence of breach or excessive permissions
Acceptance_Evidence: Scope inventory; vendor assessment; approved data-flow record; formal Central IT approval
Review_Cadence: Quarterly and whenever scopes or vendor terms change

Threat_Event: Protected data is uploaded to unsuitable GenAI service
Vulnerability_or_Control_Gap: Unclear classification guidance and planned rather than implemented enterprise controls
Recommended_Actions: Publish approved-use policy; classify data; configure enterprise controls; assess providers; train staff and students
Assumptions_and_Limitations: Minutes and feedback do not prove sensitive data was uploaded
Acceptance_Evidence: Published policy; approved provider register; enterprise control configuration; training completion record
Review_Cadence: Quarterly and after material provider or policy change
